name: email-agent
description: Install, configure and operate a privacy-first local email CLI with confirmation-gated actions.

interface.shortDescription: Install and operate private local email with explicit confirmation for sensitive actions.
interface.longDescription: Provides agent guidance for paginated read-only sync, delivery-recipient search, trash/restore lifecycle, attachment metadata and authorized extraction, platform watchers, and confirmation-gated sending and deletion.
capabilities: Search and query over the local knowledge store
Trash, restore and permanent deletion lifecycle
Attachment listing, extraction and garbage collection
defaultPrompt: Synchronize my inbox with email-agent sync and report new messages
Search my mail with email-agent query for a topic
Install Email Agent safely, verify it, and open guided setup
